executors.reason: No container or virtualization tool is installed, although the OS supports hardware virtualization and Rosetta for Linux is present. Main's linux-container profile is unconfigured and states that an emulated amd64 container is never native Linux qualification. An amd64 guest here would be emulated; Rosetta for Linux translates x86-64 code inside an arm64 guest, which is translation rather than native execution, so the same rule applies by inference. An arm64 Linux guest would run natively but fails the x86-64 pins (route E). Either needs new host tooling.
